preconditions.description: The jumble of letters is a non-empty string with a length between 1 and 10 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(word) <= 10 for word in dictionary)
preconditions.description: Each word in the dictionary is a non-empty string with a length between 1 and 10 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(sorted(jumble) == sorted(word) for word in dictionary)
preconditions.description: Each word in the dictionary can be formed from the letters in the jumble by sorting the letters of the word and comparing them to the sorted jumble.

postconditions.expression: all(match in dictionary for match in output)
postconditions.description: Each output word is a valid word from the dictionary.
The output list is sorted to match the order of the corresponding words in the dictionary.

postconditions.expression: all(sorted(jumble) == sorted(match) for match in output)
postconditions.description: Each output word can be formed from the letters in the jumble by sorting the letters of the word and comparing them to the sorted jumble.

postconditions.expression: output == [word for word in dictionary if sorted(jumble) == sorted(word)]
postconditions.description: The output list contains only those words from the dictionary that can be formed from the letters in the jumble.
